title: Implement song view counting system
description: Track when users complete watching/practicing a song. Industry standard is 30 seconds (YouTube, Spotify). For SongScript: count a 'view' when user reaches 30 seconds of practice OR 80% song completion (whichever comes first). Same user can have multiple views on same song with 5+ minute gap between counts. Store: total views, unique viewers, and average completion percentage.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add songViews table to schema (songId, userId, timestamp, completionPct, practiceTime)
Add viewCount and uniqueViewers fields to songs table
Create recordSongView mutation that validates: 30s practice OR 80% completion
Mutation enforces 5-minute cooldown per user per song (no double-counting)
Call recordSongView from frontend when threshold reached during practice
Dashboard or song page displays view count
